candidates.explanation: In the photo handling, `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }` treats an omitted photo as a request to clear it. When the user edits only their first name, the DTO has no `photo`, so `photo` becomes null. The repository update then passes `photo: null`, and the mappers (`domainEntity.photo === null`) clear the photo relation. The avatar is wiped until it is uploaded again. The check should be `=== null`, so an explicit null clears the photo and undefined leaves it unchanged. `create` already uses `=== null`.

fix.description: Change the condition from `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` to `updateUserDto.photo === null`, so a missing photo leaves it unchanged (photo stays undefined) and only an explicit null clears it.
